name: Erik Stillinger
source: Always introducing himself hy his full name, Erik Stillinger is a wannabe novelist that comes to the cafe Brooks to work on his now 3-year work in progress. Direct and lewd, Erik wastes no time when it comes to potential love interest, and he's been known to twist the truth about make himself seem more appealing. His would-be career was nearly ruined when Mr. Brooks spread a vicious rumour that Erik was a pedophile, after he caught the wannabe making eyes at his young nephew.
